theorem bbolt.Bucket.node.wp_proof [hos : HasExt osFsExt] : bbolt.Bucket.node.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.Bucket.node.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (K : bbolt.BC) (tx : Loc) (r : bbolt.TxReg) (m : Bool) (X : bbolt.WX) (bl : Loc) (B : bbolt.BRec) (pgid : w64)
    (parent : Loc),
    X.t.bs !! bl = some B →
      bl ∈ X.live →
        B.bv.nodes' ≠ null →
          (∀ (l : Loc), B.nm !! pgid = some l → l ≠ null) →
            (B.nm !! pgid = none →
                bbolt.matReady X B pgid ∧
                  (parent = null ∨ ∃ rp, B.ns !! parent = some rp ∧ rp.nv.isLeaf' = false ∧ parent ∈ X.live)) →
              ⊢
                ∀ Φ,
                  bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X -∗
                    (▷
                        ∀ l,
                          (∃ X',
                              bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X' ∗
                                ⌜B.nm !! pgid = some l ∧ X' = X ∨ bbolt.nodeAdded X X' bl l pgid parent⌝) -∗
                            Φ (intoVal l)) -∗
                      WP
                        (((intoVal
                              (methods go_etcd_io.bbolt.Bucket.ty.PointerType go!"node" (intoVal bl)))
                            (intoVal pgid))
                          (intoVal parent))
                        {{ Φ }}
